claim: Demonstrative determiners are introduced as markers of definiteness.
evidence_summary: Presentative this can introduce a new discourse entity. CGEL discusses the construction elsewhere.
finding: Cross-reference the later treatment when describing the central demonstrative use.
inference: Does marking definiteness require prior discourse familiarity for presentative this?

evidence.passage: §7.1, p. 373. Demonstrative determiners are introduced as markers of definiteness.
evidence.example: In the presentative use exemplified by There was this man …, the speaker can introduce the man for the first time. Compare the chapter’s central demonstratives with the discussions on pp. 1401 and 1510.
evidence.establishes: A cross-reference would reconcile introductory wording with a use CGEL already recognizes. Prior mention and grammatical marking of definiteness are distinct.
